route.rationale: Raised from small to standard: the one product file is packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/model_guard.rs, machine-guard source under a judge-required root. A guard and its tests written by one author prove only that the author agrees with themselves (pattern-20260812), so the close-time judge-debt door must own an independent read here rather than a lane-small ack. Substance is unchanged: configured_model_set must admit the model dispatch prepare already publishes for a herding slot's fallback:"default".
